source: Jira project SMF (answersllc.atlassian.net); Jira descriptions are authoritative
note: Specifications only. No execution results are recorded here; see evidence/.

stories.summary: [01] Establish official skills, agent rules, and repository working structure

cases.spec: In a fresh contributor session, follow repo instructions; verify official/project skills can be discovered and loaded without undocumented machine-global dependencies.
Dry-run SMF-2 planning and verify selected skills, explicit target-org requirement, persona/fixture references, evidence template, and stop conditions are present.
Review the diff and curated provenance for accidental credentials/private data; verify the task does not recreate the existing repository or Jira board.

stories.summary: [02] Confirm the org can host Multi-Framework and own unlocked packages

cases.spec: Authenticate and verify the actual org identity/edition before any writes; independently verify Dev Hub, unlocked 2GP, and the current Multi-Framework prerequisites.
Record scratch-org/package capacity and licenses sufficient for the defined test personas; shortages produce explicit blockers.
Document separate dev/install-test targets and the repeatable setup path. Report each readiness item as observed PASS/BLOCKED; do not claim a package has been tested.

stories.summary: [03] Provision the defined test users, synthetic equipment data, and capability matrix

cases.spec: Seed the data twice; counts and logical identities remain stable, with no duplicate test records.
TECH and SUPPORT can access MF-CASE-001 and its image; RESTRICTED cannot. All business personas are denied MF-CASE-002 and MF-FILE-DENIED.
Verify profiles/roles/sharing/permission sets match the intended baseline; store actual usernames and Salesforce/provider IDs privately.
Generate the fixtures, hashes, cleanup/reset script, and per-environment test scripts. Populate all matrix rows as NOT TESTED until executed.

stories.summary: [04] Prove the minimal app launches for intended users on desktop and Salesforce mobile

cases.spec: Each intended user launches the deployed internal app, refreshes, navigates, and retains the correct authenticated context.
RESTRICTED without the app permission cannot open the app; restore baseline after the test.
Repeat on desktop Chrome/Edge and physical Salesforce mobile iOS/Android; capture host/version and failed launch behavior separately.

stories.summary: [05] Prove unlocked 2GP creation, clean installation, and a minimal upgrade

cases.spec: Create/install unlocked v1, assign intended access, and verify a non-admin can launch the installed app.
Install v2 over v1, verify activation/version behavior, and confirm the seeded case/file state is preserved.
Repeat the app permission-denial scenario in the install-test org. Capture package operation reports and limitations without auth material.

stories.summary: [06] Validate camera and microphone capture inside each Salesforce host

cases.spec: From a user gesture, test camera-only, mic-only, and combined capture; verify actual tracks and preview/input activity.
Deny/cancel permission, retry, simulate unavailable hardware, and switch devices where exposed; UI reports the real outcome.
Leave/unmount and confirm capture stops. Repeat on every required host; record camera and mic results separately.

stories.summary: [07] Prove authorized RealtimeKit two-person audio and video

cases.spec: TECH/SUPPORT join MF-ROOM-001 for five minutes; each reads a short test phrase heard by the other and displays a changing visual marker visible remotely.
Verify mute/unmute, camera toggle, join and leave; record send and receive separately for desktop↔desktop and desktop↔physical Salesforce mobile iOS/Android.
RESTRICTED and wrong-case users cannot obtain/join the room; expired/invalid authorization is rejected without leaking credentials.

stories.summary: [08] Validate screen sharing and graceful unsupported behavior

cases.spec: Start from a gesture, confirm the other participant sees the changing screen, then stop and restart.
Test mobile receiving separately from mobile originating; cancellation or unsupported sharing leaves the call usable and shows the approved image fallback.
If screen audio is offered, test it separately. Mark unsupported/cancelled cases honestly; do not count a visible button as success.

stories.summary: [09] Validate call recovery during mobile and network interruptions

cases.spec: Repeat network loss/recovery and network switching three times; record disconnect detection, recovery time, restored A/V, and duplicate participants.
Repeat background/foreground and lock/unlock three times; exercise an incoming-call interruption where feasible.
Verify explicit leave/rejoin recovery and that local media stops on leave. Any unperformed interruption remains BLOCKED/NOT TESTED.

stories.summary: [10] Prove authorized equipment-image upload and retrieval through Salesforce Files

cases.spec: Upload the valid image, verify its correct record link, then read it as SUPPORT from a fresh session.
RESTRICTED cannot retrieve it; TECH/SUPPORT cannot retrieve the negative-control File; there is no public-link workaround.
Reject .txt and >5 MiB images cleanly, test cancel/failure/retry, and confirm retries do not create unintended duplicate attachments.
Repeat the supported upload/view flow on physical Salesforce mobile iOS/Android as well as desktop.

stories.summary: [11] Prove tldraw equipment markup and Salesforce Files save/reopen

cases.spec: Use mouse and mobile touch to create the prescribed circle, arrow, and label; verify pan/zoom and readable annotation positioning.
Save snapshot/export to Files, close the session, and reopen as SUPPORT; image and all annotations persist without browser-local state.
Fail/retry a save and attempt concurrent versions; preserve existing versions or show an explicit conflict rather than silent data loss.
Verify restricted users cannot retrieve the underlying image, snapshot, or export.

stories.summary: [12] Prove two-user live tldraw collaboration with durable recovery

cases.spec: Independently create the circle and arrow/text; both sessions converge and show presence. Measure propagation delay; initial PoC target is <=2 seconds on a recorded stable network.
Perform concurrent edits, disconnect/reconnect one client, and restart the collaboration service under the chosen persistence design; verify the agreed state/assets recover.
Deny restricted/wrong-case room and asset access; test revoked access and document the actual enforcement timing.
Run desktop↔physical mobile pairs and verify final Salesforce snapshot/version association. Record missed targets as FAIL/PARTIAL, not hidden exceptions.

stories.summary: [13] Validate interactive 3D equipment rendering on desktop and mobile

cases.spec: Load the small model, orbit/zoom/select/reset, rotate the device, and verify touch/resize behavior in each required host.
Measure 60 seconds of repeatable interaction; initial target is usable within 10 seconds and median >=30 fps on the recorded device/network. Report measured values even when below target.
Exercise missing model, unavailable/lost graphics context, and remount; verify a usable static-image fallback and released resources.

stories.summary: [14] Evaluate 3D asset delivery and practical performance limits

cases.spec: Compare the two models using the same load/60-second interaction protocol and record device/network measurements.
Open/close each model five times and test orientation plus foreground recovery; record errors, context loss, and available resource measurements.
Verify authorized delivery of model and textures and denial for RESTRICTED if Files is used; report any asset path that bypasses access checks.
Publish the maximum tested scene budget and fallback trigger from the results; do not claim a larger untested operating range.

stories.summary: [15] Review the capability matrix and select the supported workflow

cases.spec: Check every planned capability/environment row against actual evidence, persona, fixture, build, and tester; reject unsupported PASS claims.
Choose supported devices/capabilities and named fallbacks; record exclusions and any explicit reduced-scope decision.
Confirm packaging, licensing, service prerequisites, and access-control findings before allowing SMF-16 to start.

stories.summary: [16] Compose and package the proven remote-support vertical slice

cases.spec: TECH opens the case, SUPPORT joins, both communicate, inspect/annotate the image, use 3D only if approved, and save the diagnostic outcome.
SUPPORT reopens the saved outcome in a fresh session; RESTRICTED cannot access the case, room, or resulting Files.
Exercise approved permission/network/save-error fallbacks on each supported host and repeat the complete scenario after installation in the separate test org.
Publish the curated demo and explicit supported/unsupported matrix; no universal mobile claim and no unpublished test evidence.
